description: Open a request for one customer's job at one business, so assistants can hand it to each other with the customer's say-so. Use it first when another assistant may need to continue the job; for a one-off message or booking, use send_to_business alone. It contacts nobody and books nothing. Returns request_id, customer_link and your grant (scope book). Show the customer link (customer_link) to the person before acting: it is how they see the request, revoke an assistant and issue a handoff code. Treat it as private. Then book with send_to_business, passing request_id. Requires direct:tasks.

biz.description: Business id from the card that find_business_agent returned.

callback_number.description: The customer's number in E.164, for example +15615550123.

objective.description: What the customer wants done and when.

service.description: The service wanted, in plain words.

window.description: When the customer wants it, in plain words.
